issues.title: Minimum thickness 0.5 mm
issues.message: Thinnest wall is 0.17 mm (limit 0.50 mm), across about 4.7 mm² of the part. Walls this thin may print with gaps or not at all.
issues.suggestion: Thicken thin walls, fins and plates to at least 0.5 mm — 1.2 mm or more for strength.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 414 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 170% of the part's volume (24.0 cm³ of support for 14.1 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.
